decisions.reason: Escalation of commitment suggests management will persist with this invested and publicly launched product close to the established offer, treating the lack of archived pages as a temporary archival gap rather than evidence of failure.

Given the firm's sunk costs and responsibility for this electrostatic-dissipative shoe, management is inclined to keep it, attributing the absence of web mentions to website archiving rather than demand problems.
Because the safety shoe series is close to the firm's core business and was publicly launched, escalation of commitment leads management to retain it despite weak online evidence.
